blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Tuesday urged the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) to “pressure” the House of Representatives to meet and discuss with the Senate the Freedom of Information (FOI) bill. The Senate approved in May its version of the bill, while its counterpart measure was passed by the House in June. Read: Senate approves freedom of info bill, basic education voucher Until now, however, the two chambers could not proceed with the bicameral conference committee (bicam) meeting to reconcile the measure as the House has yet to designate its members to the panel, said Padilla, who chairs the Senate committee […]...
